Gadd, A., Tame, N., Liu, X. and Dukino, R. (2023). Pathways to decarbonisation episode seven: the electric smelting furnace. BHP Insights, BHP, 16 June 2023. https://www.bhp.com/news/bhp-insights/2023/06/pathways-to-decarbonisation-episode-seven-the-electric-smelting-furnace (web page saved 29 September 2026 as MHTML).

Web article (MHTML), no page numbers: locators are section headings and footnote numbers. Mostly qualitative: no specific energy consumption, cost or capacity is printed; the furnace charge-rate figure (EAF vs ESF operation cycles) was not captured in the MHTML (only route diagrams were saved as images). Main file: melting-furnace_electric-smelting description, state of development (pilot design with Hatch) and process CO2 from carbon additions (0.18-0.29 t/t crude steel, footnote 10). Flows: slag 250-330 kg/t hot metal. Other-values: carbon addition, slag cement credit, metallisation, power demand of a 2 Mt/yr DRI plant, DR-grade ore thresholds.
